tool_args.old_string: Our findings are demonstrated on two model families (Qwen-2.5-7B and Llama-3.1-8B) and a single dataset (UltraChat, 8K conversations); generalization to other domains (e.g., code, reasoning) is untested. Most configurations use a single seed (scheduled sampling validated on three seeds; \S\ref{subsec:ss}), and quality assessment relies on PPL rather than comprehensive benchmarks \citep{hendrycks2021measuring,lin2022truthfulqa}. LoRA rank is fixed at 16 throughout; higher ranks (32/64) might provide more capacity for the gating mechanism, potentially affecting the magnitude of the TF-AR gap, though unlikely its direction given the consistency across all five configurations. We test only one auxiliary loss family (GAR with MSE target $\tau$\,=\,0.5); head-specific or layer-specific losses may exhibit different sensitivity to exposure bias. We do not experimentally compare against split-softmax \citep{li2024measuring} or Rhea \citep{hong2025rhea}, which operate at inference time; such comparisons would clarify the practical trade-off between training-time and inference-time interventions. The PCGrad exclusion addresses gradient conflict only; magnitude imbalance \citep{chen2018gradnorm} and Nash equilibrium approaches \citep{navon2022nash} remain untested. Use of AI assistants is disclosed in Appendix~\ref{sec:appendix-ai}.

## 2. 取消所有图表悬浮，均匀分布

- 在 `main.tex` preamble 加 `\usepackage{float}`

- **注意**：正文部分图表位置和引用的逻辑关系要保持（图在第一次引用之后出现）

## 3. 所有图的图例（legend）重叠检查
